slides.texte_overlay:
sunday habits that make
your whole week better

a slow morning

start sunday with no alarm, no rush and a long breakfast. a calm morning resets your nervous system after a busy week and makes the whole day feel lighter.

a ten minute plan

write down the three things that really matter this week, nothing more. a short, clear plan stops monday from feeling chaotic before it has even begun.

learning something for fun

spend a few minutes on sunday learning something just because it's interesting, and start the week curious. a curious mind walks into monday with energy instead of dread.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning something for fun

i spend 5 minutes every sunday morning on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a painting, and starting the week curious instead of anxious changes everything.

slides.texte_overlay:
a reset of one space

tidy one room or one desk before the week starts. walking into a calm, clean space on monday morning makes it so much easier to focus and get going again.

an early night

go to bed thirty minutes earlier on sunday than usual. a well rested start to the week makes every hard task on monday feel smaller and more manageable.
